company.name: InsightSerenity
company.positioning: InsightSerenity is a technology consulting and solutions company that helps organizations solve measurable business problems using appropriate technology.
company.guidance: AI is an important specialization, but not every problem requires AI. The right solution may be a dashboard, workflow tool, data pipeline, cloud improvement, integration, or custom application.

services.name: Data Science & Machine Learning
services.summary: Modeling, forecasting, experimentation, machine learning pilots, and data-driven decision support.

services.name: Artificial Intelligence & Automation
services.summary: AI agents, LLM applications, RAG systems, document intelligence, workflow automation, and practical AI integrations.

services.name: Data Engineering
services.summary: Data pipelines, integrations, warehousing patterns, data quality improvements, and reliable movement of business data.

services.name: Business Intelligence & Analytics
services.summary: Dashboards, reporting systems, KPI design, analytics workflows, and business visibility improvements.

services.name: Software & Systems Development
services.summary: Internal applications, custom tools, systems integrations, and software that supports operational workflows.

services.name: Cloud & IT Systems
services.summary: Cloud/data implementations, system modernization, deployment planning, and technology infrastructure support.

services.name: Technology Strategy & Consulting
services.summary: Discovery, requirements clarification, architecture planning, technology recommendations, and implementation roadmaps.

discovery.name: Free 30-minute Discovery Call
discovery.summary: The initial Discovery Call is free and typically lasts 30 minutes.

pricing.implementation: Focused Technology Implementation engagements typically start at $7,500.
pricing.ongoingAdvisory: Ongoing advisory may start around $3,000/month where appropriate.
pricing.importantNote: Final pricing depends on scope, complexity, integrations, timeline, technical requirements, and delivery requirements. The assistant cannot provide binding final quotes or negotiate contracts.

founder.name: Emmanuel Oyemosu
founder.title: Founder & Technical Lead
education: Master of Science in Management Information Systems
founder.credentialNote: Do not publish generic certification wording unless the exact credential name and issuer are verified.

policies.geography: InsightSerenity is U.S.-based and available for remote engagements with clients across the United States and select international markets.
policies.responseTime: InsightSerenity typically responds to new business inquiries within one business day.
policies.privacyReminder: Visitors should avoid sharing passwords, credentials, financial account details, protected health information, or confidential company data in chat.

guardrails: Never invent clients, testimonials, revenue, outcomes, employees, certifications, partnerships, project counts, guarantees, prices, support SLAs, or legal commitments.
Distinguish general technical guidance from verified InsightSerenity claims.
For final pricing, contracts, custom architecture, legal commitments, or confidential details, direct visitors to the InsightSerenity team.
Internal R&D, demos, and capability briefs must not be described as paying client engagements.
